# StatisticsTimes.com

> > A comprehensive statistics and data visualization platform providing economic, demographic, geographic, and social indicators for countries, continents, and regions worldwide.

StatisticsTimes.com aggregates global statistical data from authoritative sources like the IMF, UN, and national governments, presenting economic rankings, population demographics, geographic metrics, and comparative country analysis. The site specializes in detailed breakdowns for India at state and district levels alongside world-wide statistics.

## Key Topics

- GDP growth and economic indicators
- Population and demographic statistics
- Country rankings and comparisons
- India state-level data
- World economic data
- Sex ratio and age demographics
- Geographic statistics
- Sports statistics
- Technology rankings
- Political election results
- Continental breakdowns
- Life expectancy metrics
- Per capita indicators
- Global rankings indices
- Asian countries data

## Global Economic Statistics

- [Economy (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/economy/world-statistics.php): Global GDP rankings and economic indicators for countries and continents
- [Economy (Country) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/economy/country-statistics.php): Country-by-country economic data including GDP, growth rates, and per capita metrics
- [Countries by GDP Growth 2025](https://statisticstimes.com/economy/countries-by-projected-gdp-growth.php): IMF projected GDP growth rates for 194 countries and economies through 2025

## Global Demographic Statistics

- [Demographics (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/world-statistics.php): Global population, density, life expectancy, and sex ratio demographic data
- [Demographics (Country) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/country-statistics.php): Country-level demographic statistics on population, density, life expectancy
- [Continents by Population 2025](https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/continents-by-population.php): UN-based continental population estimates with growth rates and projections
- [United States Sex Ratio 2026](https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/country/us-sex-ratio.php): US gender demographics and sex ratio by age group from 1950-2100 projections

## India-Specific Statistics

- [Economy (India) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/economy/india-statistics.php): India economy statistics by state including GDP, growth, and sector analysis
- [Demographics (India) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/india-statistics.php): India population and sex ratio statistics by state and district levels
- [Politics (India) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/politics/india-statistics.php): India election results and political statistics for Lok Sabha and state assemblies
- [Geography (India) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/geography/india-statistics.php): India geographic data and statistics by state including area measurements
- [Sports (India) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/sports/india-statistics.php): India sports statistics focusing on IPL cricket and Indian Premier League data

## Global Rankings and Comparisons

- [Ranking (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/ranking/world-statistics.php): Global rankings including Peace Index, Innovation Index, and Democracy Index

## Geography and Sports Statistics

- [Geography (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/geography/world-statistics.php): Geographic statistics of countries and continents with continental breakdowns
- [Sports (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/sports/world-statistics.php): World sports statistics covering Olympics, Cricket World Cup, and Asian Games

## Technology Statistics

- [Tech (World) Statistics](https://statisticstimes.com/tech/world-statistics.php): Global technology statistics including computer languages and tech rankings

## Core Navigation

- [StatisticsTimes.com Homepage](https://statisticstimes.com/index.php): Homepage showcasing statistics collections on economy, population, geography, sports
